commits.body:
Four modules in web/layer-*.js, mounted by main.js; hooks are module constants written as node
extras by lib/live.layer_extras() (any layout, no room coordinates in JS). build.py ships
scan_points.json (16k vase points sorted by projector row). The projector casts a Gray-code
sequence (columns then rows, with inverses) through a ray-marched haze beam onto every baked mesh
in its frustum, then the vase dissolves into its lidar-shaded point cloud and settles back.
gates.py: live_gates (layers mounted, each draws, draw calls, chamber and Geiger Poisson bounds,
eraser crop change and a real click, sound opt-in, reduced motion, first-load run). All green;
numbers in TARGETS.md.

commits.subject: room: live layers polish - eraser footprint patch and wider split, Geiger lever stub, TARGETS rows updated for the live layers
room/film: projector live-action film (Gray-code beam in haze, vase to point cloud)
commits.body:
Standalone Cycles script, not part of the room build: a spot light at projector_cam
projects Gray-code row patterns through volumetric haze; the vase dissolves into a
simulated scan (cos/r^2 intensity, range noise, grazing dropouts, self-occlusion)
under a sweeping lidar line, then settles back. Renders go to room/film/out/ (ignored).

iterations.message: Pipeline spike: Python drives Blender, Cycles bake, three.js. One hero object: a 70s amp with VU meters (a guess, before the real L-308).
Floor + sideboard shell, embedded glTF, three.js via +esm (the artifact sandbox ignored the import map).
Seven objects built in parallel on studio sets: Luxman L-308, Barco-style projector, cloud chamber, Geiger + scope, optical table with quantum eraser, C64 + TI-83, bookshelf.
Full room at dusk: workbench, all objects placed, viewpoint nav, cloud-chamber glass. No live layers yet.

Live layers: Gray-code projection with a beam in haze, vase dissolves into its lidar point cloud; cloud chamber tracks (PDG flux, cos²θ); Geiger at ~20 CPM with pulses on the scope; quantum eraser toggle.
Four big-space atelier layouts (black box, scan stage, ceiling rig, long hall). Rejected by Ruud: too big, lost the coziness.
Cozy variant: attic atelier, Barco on the rug centre, hanging form, skylight stars, bulb string. Agent's pick.
Cozy variant: canal-house back room, Barco on the central table, vase on a plinth before the bookcase.
Cozy variant: the loved dusk room pulled back, Barco centre floor, hanging form between visitor and bench.
Ruud's canal house at night from open data (3D BAG/BGT): real boats, quay trees, rain on glass, water reflections; UvA to the left, not straight across
14 profile props placed (listening corner with DM603 + iFi + HD660, bench curiosities, wheel, prism), generic glass, audio + hotspots + lidar wired
Panel 013 merge: B camera + C quay + D front door + A light rig (ported by hand); skip pill off contact; LIVE card top right
Canal detail (house row, quay walls, arch bridge, water streaks) + least-action intro on the old route (bead on a wire, 10 s) + English least-action poster
KTX2+meshopt (7.9->4.5 MB), work sheet + phone caption + calm glows, on-demand water mirror, AgX roll-off in live layers, visible chamber tracks, poster 2048
Round 016 merge: B camera+nav+toast, A stripes/rain/light, D chamber+eraser+camera, C street without canopy, plaster ceiling
Plato head projection-mapped (Gray-code, lidar, colour) + green C64 with hand-written BASIC, click-to-move camera, ?dev restart flight
Click-through navigation (C base + A/B/D grafts): one click to every case and back, per-view URL, outside means back, eraser by clicking, thinner tags
Head-like camera moves (0.8-1.3 s), desktop walk via standpoints, Table and Bookcase views, chamber pulled back, wall reframed, inherited bugs cleared, glow as light
Binders on the shelf, chimney breast and door, rose at room centre, polarizer at 60% clickable, mailto acts, raindrop hot point (Abram), raycast gate
